reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1001. Lower bound is an independent set of size 1001 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_5 of length 1001 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true). Agent took wall 99.864 s (compute 82.932 s, LLM 16.932 s over 2 calls, 1 critic round, 1 code tried). Baselines: kushagra_agent also proved 1001 exactly via F_5 in 4.38 s, roughly 23x faster than this agent, a clear loss on time. CP-SAT alpha found 1001 but unproven at 123.29 s; CP-SAT cover timed out; fractional cover gave only 3003; F_2 minrank SAT reached lower 1000 without an upper. Nothing suspicious; own_rank not possible since N = 3003 > 2500.
